notes.title: Update 0.197
notes.notes:
[h2]New Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Core Virtues:[/b] Four new skillable core virtues have been added, enhancing health, damage, shield, and speed.
[*] [b]Custom Input:[/b] You can now set custom input buttons for keyboard and gamepad controls.
[*] [b]Enemy Variety:[/b] Several new enemy types have been introduced.
[*] [b]Map Layouts:[/b] Map layouts have been reworked for improved gameplay flow.
[*] [b]Quest Indicator:[/b] A visual quest indicator has been added for better navigation.
[*] [b]Object Restoration:[/b] Gain the ability to restore damaged objects in the environment.
[*] [b]Animal Handling:[/b] Acquire ingredients from animals without harming them.
[*] [b]Magnetic Field:[/b] Collect items effortlessly with a magnetic field ability.
[*] [b]Restorative Healing:[/b] Automatically heal when you remain stationary.
[*] [b]Charged Spells:[/b] Charge your spells while walking for increased potency.
[*] [b]Independent Aiming:[/b] Shoot spells in any direction, regardless of your movement.
[*] [b]Keyboard Key Display:[/b] See the relevant keys displayed when playing with a keyboard.
[*] [b]Ultimate Spell:[/b] The ultimate ability is now a spell that requires activation.
[*] [b]Auto-fire Option:[/b] Activate auto-fire for your spells (reduces wizard spell damage by 25%).
[*] [b]Auto-aim Option:[/b] Activate auto-aim for your spells (reduces wizard spell damage by 25%).
[*] [b]Sound Volume Control:[/b] Adjust the sound volume to your preference.
[*] [b]Item and Potion Slots:[/b] Unlock item and potion slots using your wizard level and gold.
[*] [b]Item and Potion Charges:[/b] Items and potions now have charges instead of real-time expiration. Items can be recharged, but potions cannot.
[*] [b]Euphoria System:[/b] Euphoria no longer expires in real time. Gain 2% power per quest and bonus quest.
[*] [b]Ultimate Form VFX:[/b] New visual effects enhance your ultimate form.
[*] [b]Destructible Environment:[/b] More world objects are now destructible.
[*] [b]Southern Route:[/b] Added a southern route on Map 1.
[*] [b]Map Rework:[/b] Map 4 (Hell of Hatred) has been significantly reworked.
[/list]
[h2]Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Mastery Rework:[/b] Masteries have been redesigned for improved balance and effectiveness.
[*] [b]Discomfort:[/b] Reduces the required number of kills during a run.
[*] [b]Lifestyle:[/b] Increases the effects of all temporary items.
[*] [b]Attachments:[/b] Increases the area of magnetic pull for items and gold.
[*] [b]Harmony:[/b] Increases the area within which you can restore nature objects.
[*] [b]Respect:[/b] Increases the effective area of animal handling.
[*] [b]Meditation:[/b] Increases the healing effect when resting.
[*] [b]Time Training Removed:[/b] The Time Training feature has been removed.
[*] [b]Item Sales:[/b] Items that don't match your wizard magic type can now be sold.
[*] [b]SteamDeck:[/b] Is now supported
[/list]
[h2]Important Notes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Storage Rework:[/b] The storage system has been reworked, resulting in a progress reset.
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Several bug fixes have been implemented to improve overall game stability and performance.
[/list]
